subject: Daz
fact: Daz refused to wear the offered armor.
source_quote: Daz refused, saying armor would only slow him down

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes he is a nobody with no house affiliation and no apparent strategic value.
source_quote: You don't belong to any noble house, your background is a complete mystery, you suddenly show up, and all of a sudden, we're contracted to protect a nobody.

subject: Daz's identity
fact: Daz wants to know why someone in Menzoberranzan paid a lot to protect him, but the reason is not specified in this session.
source_quote: I literally have no idea why there's all this focus on me.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira noticed the anomaly of Daz being protected despite having no noble house or lineage.
source_quote: That is an excellent question. You don't belong to any noble house, your background is a complete mystery, you suddenly show up, and all of a sudden, we're contracted to protect a nobody.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira believes Daz is likely suffering from daddy issues and self-mythologizing.
source_quote: Yes, yes, yes, that's what every orphan thinks. Do you have daddy issues? Do you have mommy issues? Every drow thinks there's some noble things.

subject: Nym
fact: Nym dismissed the threat of Asha Vandree as insignificant compared to Daz's survival.
source_quote: If Daz can't protect himself from a low-level cult initiate of Lolth, then quite frankly, whoever paid for his survival deserves to lose his money.

subject: Nym
fact: Nym stated that the fee for protecting Daz is a price Daz cannot afford.
source_quote: That is a fee... that is a price you cannot afford.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir killed Asha Vandree to prevent her from invoking Lolth's power.
source_quote: The Eldritch Claw Tattoo doesn't announce itself. One moment I was behind her, the next my hands were something else — longer, reaching — and the strikes came in sequence... Asha Vandree did not get another word out.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin grappled Asha Vandree to prevent her from speaking.
source_quote: He crossed the distance and got his hands on her — properly, a full grapple, one hand clamped over her mouth before she could invoke anything else.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira applauded Zalthir's killing of Asha Vandree as a necessary act.
source_quote: Well done, well done, well done! See, he wasn't completely defenseless.

subject: The payer's identity
fact: The identity of the person who paid to protect Daz is not specified in this session.
source_quote: Someone in Menzoberranzan had spent generously — they interrupt you, a lot — to ensure that a male Drow apostate with no house affiliation and no apparent strategic value survived...

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir decided to act decisively when others hesitated.
source_quote: I'm making a call," I said. I stepped in.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believes someone had to make the call to kill Asha Vandree, and he was the one who did.
source_quote: Someone had to make the call. I made it. That's all.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum attempted to use divine light against Asha Vandree, but it missed.
source_quote: He leveled something at her — a directed burst of divine light that should have taken her off her feet — and it missed...

subject: Nym
fact: Nym criticized Thorin for not killing Asha Vandree immediately.
source_quote: When attacking a cleric of Lolth, Thorin, one does not just simply grapple them. One takes your blade and cuts their heads off.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira observed that Thorin and the party had made it this far despite their flawed methods.
source_quote: It's amazing that you people have made it this far.

subject: The origin of the contract
fact: The reason the contract to protect Daz was initiated is not specified in this session.
source_quote: For all you know, the reason this all got started was because they all decided to be friends with the wrong drow.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir did not look at Asha Vandree's body after killing her.
source_quote: I didn't look at the body.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believes his action was true and reasonable, even if others' hesitations were also true.
source_quote: I just happened to also be true.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz asked the obvious question about the contract terms.
source_quote: What is the terms of your contract, just to make sure that I... am alive, or that I won this particular battle?

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira clarified that the contract was to prevent other drow factions from killing Daz.
source_quote: Our terms of our contract were to make sure that the other drow factions didn't get you killed.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira noted that the T'sarran goons were to be handled personally if needed.
source_quote: They'd been prepared to handle the T'sarran contingent personally if it came to that.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira said the three bravos were not sincere.
source_quote: Three *bravos*. I have found, as a general principle, that a third *bravo* is never sincere.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz thanked the sisters for their help.
source_quote: Hey guys, thanks for the help.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asked what it would cost to retain the sisters.
source_quote: He asked what it would cost.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir recalled a class on decisive action under moral uncertainty.
source_quote: There was a class for this. Decisive action under moral uncertainty — the ethics of necessary violence, or something like that.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz suggested auditing the payer's books.
source_quote: You know what would help? To audit their books.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz wondered if there was more to him than meets the eye.
source_quote: So then maybe there's more to me than meets the eye?

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira said they were not paid to think too hard about Daz's identity.
source_quote: Perhaps, but we're not paid to think that hard.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz described feeling small and very important at the edge of a life-changing question.
source_quote: He called it *standing at the edge of the question that changes everything.* He said you could always recognize it because it made you feel very small and very important at the same time.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum felt the particular weight of irony settle in his chest when handling the keys.
source_quote: I turned them over in my hands and felt the particular weight of irony settle in my chest.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum said the keys would have been very useful in the very beginning.
source_quote: You know, they would have been very useful in the very beginning,

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted that these are the very keys that had you imprisoned.
source_quote: These are the very keys that had you imprisoned.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum wanted to understand the room before he started carrying things out of it.
source_quote: I wanted to understand the room before I started carrying things out of it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum opened the confiscated prisoner belongings and found exactly what he expected.
source_quote: I opened it, and the contents were exactly what you would expect from someone who understood that stripping a prisoner of their possessions is the first act of stripping them of themselves.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum said, 'If there was anything that was missing from the very beginning, like your tooth, Thorin.'
source_quote: If there was anything that was missing from the very beginning," I said, not quite finishing the thought, "like your tooth, Thorin.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin looked up and something shifted in his face — recognition, and then something quieter beneath it.
source_quote: Thorin looked up. Something shifted in his face — recognition, and then something quieter beneath it.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin said, 'Oh, yeah. I want my tooth back.'
source_quote: Oh, yeah. I want my tooth back.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin reached in and found the tooth and held it for a moment without saying anything.
source_quote: He reached in and found it. He held it for a moment without saying anything.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin said, 'Very sentimental.'
source_quote: Very sentimental.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara had been carrying Thorin's tooth around the Underdark and collected it like a curiosity.
source_quote: she had been carrying his tooth around the Underdark. She had collected it like a curiosity.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum held the water-damaged journal carefully and noted the handwriting was still visible in the drier sections.
source_quote: I held it carefully. The pages were swollen and the ink had run in places, but the handwriting was still visible in the drier sections,

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum took note of the marks of a person who had kept records right up until they couldn't.
source_quote: the marks of a person who had kept records right up until they couldn't.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum received the flask of Overbright brandy with considerably more personal interest.
source_quote: The flask of Overbright brandy I received with considerably more personal interest.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree had been a cleric of Lolth who had also become, in some capacity, a cleric of Zuggtmoy, and in the end she had been indistinguishable from the rot she served.
source_quote: Asha Vandree had been a cleric of Lolth who had also become, in some capacity, a cleric of Zuggtmoy, and in the end she had been indistinguishable from the rot she served.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum looted Asha Vandree with the efficient respect one extends to a theological problem that has been resolved.
source_quote: So I looted her with the efficient respect one extends to a theological problem that has been resolved.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir took the Drow cloak she'd been wearing — the fine spider-silk kind that drinks shadow — and Grygum did not begrudge him that.
source_quote: Zalthir took the Drow cloak she'd been wearing — the fine spider-silk kind that drinks shadow — and I did not begrudge him that.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum suspected the sealed wax pouch was the more interesting item.
source_quote: I had the wax pouch, and I suspected it was the more interesting item.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum read the sealed wax pouch and found pages of close, careful script — the handwriting of someone who had once been methodical, who had trained as a theologian and brought that training to bear on a question that should not have been asked.
source_quote: Inside were pages of close, careful script — the handwriting of someone who had once been methodical, who had trained as a theologian and brought that training to bear on a question that should not have been asked.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum said, 'It's basically a long theological exploration of why Zuggtmoy and Lolth — and claiming that Lolth and Zuggtmoy are the same thing,'
source_quote: It's basically a long theological exploration of why Zuggtmoy and Lolth — and claiming that Lolth and Zuggtmoy are the same thing,

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum said, 'It's very tedious and boring.'
source_quote: It's very tedious and boring.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum understood the written record of a mind finding its way toward the conclusion that two incompatible things were secretly one thing — the kind of reasoning that starts from a desired destination and works backward.
source_quote: what it actually was, was the written record of a mind finding its way toward the conclusion that two incompatible things were secretly one thing — the kind of reasoning that starts from a desired destination and works backward.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum asked, 'Is this pre-craziness or post-craziness, do you think?'
source_quote: Is this pre-craziness or post-craziness, do you think?" I asked.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum examined Ilvara's prayer book gingerly.
source_quote: I'll examine it gingerly.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted the main text was a standard Lolth prayer book — formatted prayers, liturgical responses, the hierarchy of supplication laid out in careful descending order.
source_quote: The main text was a standard Lolth prayer book — the kind of thing they give to promising young acolytes in the outer sanctums of any major drow religious house. Formatted prayers. Liturgical responses. The hierarchy of supplication laid out in careful descending order.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted the marginalia were in a different hand and showed the corruption timeline.
source_quote: but you notice it has Zuggtmoy marginalia — the margins in a different hand — since it shows the corruption timeline.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum observed that the early entries were neat and formal and exactly what you would expect.
source_quote: The early entries were neat and formal and exactly what you would expect.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum observed that the second voice in the marginalia was less structured, more associative, and some sentences didn't always end.
source_quote: Then, gradually, around the margins, a second voice crept in. Less structured. More associative. The sentences didn't always end. Some of them were questions that answered themselves with other questions.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum recalled seeing something like this before — a merchant Tongued by a bardic curse whose correspondence was eerily similar.
source_quote: I had seen something like this before, in a completely different context — a merchant I once knew who had been Tongued by a bardic curse, whose correspondence from that period was eerily similar:

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted the corruption timeline was legible if you knew how to read it.
source_quote: The corruption timeline was legible if you knew how to read it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum thought, briefly, of Stroud sitting down across from Protanther — four hundred years of preparation, still had a blind spot.
source_quote: I thought, briefly, of Stroud sitting down across from Protanther. Four hundred years of preparation. Still had a blind spot.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum read the sealed orders from House Mizzrym aloud: 'Where are you? What have you been doing? Respond — kind of thing. You've gone missing. Followed by more frantic: where are you, where are you? Didn't you read the previous memo? What's up?'
source_quote: Where are you? What have you been doing? Respond — kind of thing. You've gone missing. Followed by more frantic: where are you, where are you? Didn't you read the previous memo? What's up?

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted the letter from Neverlight Grove was a missed meeting — political correspondence that had gone nowhere because the person it was addressed to had gone somewhere else.
source_quote: A missed meeting. Political correspondence that had gone nowhere, because the person it was addressed to had gone somewhere else — somewhere a Demon Queen's influence had been a stronger pull than any political alliance.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum said the sealed orders were someone's records of a relationship that had dissolved without anyone on one end knowing why.
source_quote: They were someone's records of a relationship that had dissolved without anyone on one end knowing why.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum described the Living Serpent Head Scourge as a great museum piece.
source_quote: The Living Serpent Head Scourge sounds... It sounds like a great museum piece.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed that acknowledging the craft of terrible items is not the same as endorsing what the craft served.
source_quote: There is a tradition, in certain temples I have visited, of displaying items that are terrible in origin and remarkable in craft, on the theory that acknowledging the craft is not the same as endorsing what the craft served.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum documented the items carefully and did not pretend they weren't what they were.
source_quote: You document them. You label them carefully. You do not pretend they aren't what they are.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum took notes instead of saying much about any of the items.
source_quote: I took notes instead.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin carries the necromantic pearl as a marker of how far the corruption had spread by the time they arrived.
source_quote: I had the necromantic pearl in one pocket. I'd already turned over the question of what it meant — something this finished, this dense, at the core of a corrupted fungal mass that Ilvara had been using as a ritual anchor.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin carries Ilvara's recovered tooth as a marker of where they started.
source_quote: It was settled now. I had the tooth back. And I had the pearl that had been buried in the heart of whatever she'd turned this place into.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin recognized the necromantic pearl as something deliberately placed, not accidental.
source_quote: The pearl wasn't in the wrong place by accident. Someone had put something like it there, or something like it had grown there because the conditions were exactly right for it.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin retrieved Ilvara's tooth from her trophy collection.
source_quote: She'd taken my tooth. A chip broken off in the capture, displayed in her chest like a piece of evidence of what she could do.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin pocketed the incense cones, silver bowl, and stitched cloth bearing Lolth's web and Zuggtmoy's mark.
source_quote: Inside: incense cones, a silver bowl small enough to fit in one hand, and a cloth that had been stitched with two sigils — Lolth's web worked into the eight-fold geometry of Zuggtmoy's mark, one woven inside the other.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin identified the stitched cloth as Ilvara's madness made physical.
source_quote: It was evidence. It was Ilvara's madness made physical — the thing she'd built her rituals around while she was becoming something that served two masters and understood neither.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin recognized the T'sarran signet ring on the dead mage’s finger.
source_quote: I found the signet ring first — House T'sarran, the seal unmistakable on the face of it.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin examined the partially burned documents revealing the contract to extract Daz alive and unharmed.
source_quote: Then the documents. They'd been partially burned, which meant someone had tried to destroy them and hadn't quite managed it, which meant the information in them was exactly the kind of thing worth knowing.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin confirmed the contract was from House T'sarran to extract Daz alive and unharmed.
source_quote: There had been a contract. Extract Daz alive and unharmed. House T'sarran behind it.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin showed the documents to Nym and Kaelira.
source_quote: We showed the documents to Nym and Kaelira.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin observed Nym's expressive irritation and Kaelira's professional stillness as they read the documents.
source_quote: Nym had the kind of face that gets more expressive the more irritated she becomes, and right now she was very expressive. Kaelira was the opposite — still and professional, reading the burned pages with the focus of someone who was paid to be good at exactly this.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin heard Nym question Daz's mysterious origins and the cost of the contract.
source_quote: That is an excellent question. You don't belong to any noble house, your background is a complete mystery, you suddenly show up, and all of a sudden, we're contracted to protect a nobody. Do you know how much money that required us to get, for us to do? A lot. Like, they interrupt you. A lot.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin heard Daz respond to Nym with, 'So then maybe there's more to me than meets the eye?'
source_quote: Daz looked at her with something behind his eyes that I couldn't quite read. He let a beat pass, and then he said: 'So then maybe there's more to me than meets the eye?'

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin heard Kaelira say, 'Perhaps, but we're not paid to think that hard.'
source_quote: Kaelira said, without looking up from the documents: 'Perhaps, but we're not paid to think that hard.'

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin observed Daz's reaction to the questions about his identity as restrained.
source_quote: Which was, I thought, the most restrained thing he could possibly have said in that moment.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin saw Daz reach for the wand — obsidian with a captive spider in amber — and noted its significance.
source_quote: Then the wand: obsidian, a captive spider preserved in amber at its tip.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin watched Daz and Dawnbringer negotiate the use of the sunblade in a purification ritual.
source_quote: Dawnbringer disagreed. 'I'm not some kind of magical wizard thingy that purifies things. I am a high-quality sunblade. I kill things. I will not be treated like a religious symbol to be used and waved over corrupt—'

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin used the Vaultmaster Locking Scabbard to persuade Dawnbringer to participate in the ritual.
source_quote: Thorin reached, unhurriedly, for the scabbard. 'Do I need to show you the scabbard again?'

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin noted Dawnbringer's concession: 'I suppose I could do you this one. I could do this solid for you.'
source_quote: I suppose…" Dawnbringer began, and then, with the dignity of someone granting a significant concession: "I suppose I could do you this one. I could do this solid for you.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin observed the comfortable rhythm of repetition between himself and Dawnbringer.
source_quote: They had been here before, the dwarf and his sword. They would be here again.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a male Drow apostate from Menzoberranzan who studied magic and held private opinions that would have gotten him killed if voiced aloud.
source_quote: I am a male Drow apostate from Menzoberranzan who studied magic, held private opinions that would have gotten him killed if voiced aloud, and eventually ended up in Velkynvelve's cages alongside a dwarf raised by giants and a dragonborn who doesn't talk much.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz has no distinguished lineage and no significant House affiliation.
source_quote: My lineage is not distinguished. My House, if I ever truly had one, is not significant.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz expressed confusion about why powerful Drow houses would spend resources to extract him.
source_quote: I said as much to the group — that I was, genuinely, confused. That powerful Drow houses do not spend this kind of resource on nobodies.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz proposed investigating the contract together and splitting any proceeds.
source_quote: I think," I said, keeping my voice very even, "that we should investigate this together. Whatever we find — whoever is behind this, whatever they think I'm worth — we split the proceeds.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted Nym and Kaelira’s sardonic skepticism about his possible noble origins.
source_quote: They had opinions, the sisters, about mysterious orphans who arrive at adulthood convinced they have noble blood waiting somewhere.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz privately catalogued the possibility of noble blood as embarrassing.
source_quote: I have, privately, catalogued that possibility and found it embarrassing.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz filed the question of his identity away to return to at inconvenient moments.
source_quote: I filed the question where I file most things that don't have immediate answers — in the part of my mind that I return to at inconvenient moments — and let the conversation move on.

subject: Daz's true identity
fact: Daz's true identity and the reason for the contract to extract him remain unverified and unresolved.
source_quote: The honest answer — the one I kept arriving at and then setting aside — was that I had no idea why.

subject: The contracting party behind House T'sarran
fact: The identity of the party who commissioned House T'sarran to extract Daz alive and unharmed remains unknown.
source_quote: The contracting party was unknown even to them.

subject: The origin of the necromantic pearl
fact: The origin of the necromantic pearl — whether placed or grown — remains unexplained.
source_quote: Either answer was a problem that needed a name.

subject: Ilvara's connection to Zuggtmoy and Lolth
fact: The nature and extent of Ilvara's connection to Zuggtmoy and Lolth, as evidenced by the stitched cloth, remains unexplored.
source_quote: It was Ilvara's madness made physical — the thing she'd built her rituals around while she was becoming something that served two masters and understood neither.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin wrapped up the incense cones, silver bowl, and stitched cloth before moving on.
source_quote: I wrapped it back up and moved on.

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin passed through the bodies of the dead soldiers of House Mizzrym without praying.
source_quote: I didn't pray over them. They'd come here doing what they were told by someone who had already lost her mind, and I had nothing to say to them that wasn't just 'better luck in another life.'

subject: Thorin Giantfriend
fact: Thorin collected gold, short swords, a long sword, and a steel whistle from the dead guards.
source_quote: Gold, short swords, a long sword, a steel whistle.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz acknowledged the road to the surface waited, unresolved questions in tow.
source_quote: Around me, the road to the surface waited. I had an unanswered question about my own identity sitting unresolved in my chest...

subject: Daz
fact: Daz accepted that some questions are carried, not audited.
source_quote: Some things you audit. Some things you simply carry.

subject: I
fact: I had stopped counting the steps because counting had started to feel like superstition, like I was measuring the distance against the possibility of failure.
source_quote: I had stopped counting the steps somewhere around the third hour of climbing — not because I lost track, but because counting had started to feel like superstition, like I was measuring the distance against the possibility of failure.

subject: I
fact: I had been thinking about the moment of the Overbright, intermittently, for months, not with anticipation exactly — anticipation implies you trust the thing to happen.
source_quote: I had been thinking about this moment, intermittently, for months. Not with anticipation exactly — anticipation implies you trust the thing to happen.

subject: I
fact: I had been carrying the Overbright through Velkynvelve and Gracklstugh and the Darklake and Blingdenstone like a stone in a pocket, something I reached for when the tunnels pressed too close.
source_quote: The Overbright was a concept I had been carrying through Velkynvelve and Gracklstugh and the Darklake and Blingdenstone like a stone in a pocket, something I reached for when the tunnels pressed too close.

subject: I
fact: I knew that Drow cloaks disintegrated in the sunlight.
source_quote: I knew that Drow cloaks disintegrated in the sunlight.

subject: The class on material impermanence
fact: There was a class for this — some form of material impermanence — I think it was Brother Quellin, or possibly the tall one whose name I never quite caught, the one who always had chalk dust on his robe. The transience of tools. The attachment to implements. Something about a bowl and an empty hand.
source_quote: There was a class for this. Some form of material impermanence — I think it was Brother Quellin, or possibly the tall one whose name I never quite caught, the one who always had chalk dust on his robe. The transience of tools. The attachment to implements. Something about a bowl and an empty hand.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum had opened the bag of holding just enough, and Glabbagool — our companion, our gelatinous ward who was now a grey ooze — had peered out.
source_quote: Grygum had opened the bag of holding just enough, and Glabbagool — our companion, our gelatinous ward who was now a grey ooze, the most improbable relationship any of us had formed in the Underdark, which was saying something given the competition — had peered out.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool had peered out, wide and present and sweeping across the surface world with an attention that made my own response to the Overbright seem, by comparison, measured.
source_quote: He peered. He had not been in sunlight before. None of us were entirely sure what Glabbagool's eyes were, from a structural standpoint, but they were wide and present and sweeping across the surface world with an attention that made my own response to the Overbright seem, by comparison, measured.

subject: I
fact: I watched him watch the sky.
source_quote: I watched him watch the sky.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum was doing something with his hands that was probably prayer and probably sincere.
source_quote: Grygum was doing something with his hands that was probably prayer and probably sincere.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was, I suspected, already drafting a journal entry.
source_quote: Daz was, I suspected, already drafting a journal entry.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz's particular analytical gravity was already pulling the decision toward a conclusion before the conversation began.
source_quote: The decision about what to do with the months was largely Daz's call, framed as a group discussion but with Daz's particular analytical gravity already pulling it toward a conclusion before the conversation began.

subject: Daz
fact: The conclusion — Candlekeep, the Great Library, research into House T'sarran and Jimjar's disappearance and whatever the various cutouts and hired Duskryns were ultimately pointing at regarding Daz's own history — was reasonable.
source_quote: The conclusion — Candlekeep, the Great Library, research into House T'sarran and Jimjar's disappearance and whatever the various cutouts and hired Duskryns were ultimately pointing at regarding Daz's own history — was reasonable.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin was thinking about Dawnbringer — not what to do with it; he would never give it up, and the sword would never go quietly. But what it had been through.
source_quote: Thorin, characteristically, was thinking about Dawnbringer. Not what to do with it; he would never give it up, and the sword would never go quietly. But what it had been through.

subject: Thorin's sword whisperer
fact: Thorin had mentioned something about a specialist — the phrase *sword whisperer* had come up, delivered with the particular dwarvish seriousness that Thorin applied to things he actually cared about, which meant he believed this person existed and should be found.
source_quote: He had mentioned something about a specialist — the phrase *sword whisperer* had come up, delivered with the particular dwarvish seriousness that Thorin applied to things he actually cared about, which meant he believed this person existed and should be found.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum was the only one among us who had accumulated a list of things he wanted to read, and Candlekeep was going to be, for him, something between research and pilgrimage.
source_quote: Grygum had pamphlets on his mind. This was entirely consistent. Grygum was the only one among us who had accumulated a list of things he wanted to read, and Candlekeep was going to be, for him, something between research and pilgrimage.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum would look up the lore of Bahamut. He would pick up pamphlets. He would be genuinely delighted by the availability of pamphlets.
source_quote: He would look up the lore of Bahamut. He would pick up pamphlets. He would be genuinely delighted by the availability of pamphlets.
